svg.text: MISSION CONTROL inside the Pulse shell
Every action waits for your approval.
✓ Acts on its own: continue only. Everything else always waits for you.
Autonomy strip retired. Pulse.tsx:459 says it belongs BELOW the console; it renders above (465 vs 478).
It duplicated Settings' 'Pulse orchestrator' panel — whose own empty state already said 'Turn it on in Settings'.
Scan chrome (3d window · FAST/MED/SLOW · Scan now) removed from the ROUTE. PulseSettings keeps the capability.
OBJECTIVES + TIMELINE become a persistent column that also renders with no mission selected (was: neither, ≥1400px).
Filter chips stay — they narrow the live session list, which is a MISSION CONTROL surface.
A read-only DEGRADED badge stays on the console (see states sheet).
ADOPT semantics unchanged: it still means 'into an existing mission'.
The /pulse route path — #895 settled it; saved links keep working.
Project + agent filter chips, and the untracked session list.
